hook.convey: one whole stretch from start = 0 to finish = 1; stopping exactly halfway → standing on a real spot → 0 and 1 have no name for it → fractions are numbers that live between 0 and 1

use.hi: Cricket pitch ko ek number line socho: ek stump 0 par hai aur doosra stump 1 par. Batsman run ke liye bhaaga aur theek beech mein ruk gaya. Woh pitch ke ek pakke spot par khada hai, aur us spot ka bhi ek number hota hai.

use.hi: Ghar 0 par hai aur school 1 km par. School bus aadhe raaste mein ruk gayi. Bus na 0 par hai, na 1 par, woh beech ke ek spot par hai, aur us spot ka bhi number hota hai.

use.hi: Game mein level ka progress bar 0 se shuru hota hai aur 1 par level poora hota hai. Abhi bar aadha bhara hai, toh woh 0 aur 1 ke beech ke ek number par ruka hai.

prompt.hi: Screen par 0 se 2 tak ki line hai, aur har poora 3 barabar gaps mein bata hai. 5/3 kin do poore numbers ke beech aata hai?
prompt.en: On the screen is a line from 0 to 2, each whole split into 3 equal gaps. Between which two whole numbers does 5/3 lie?

prompt.hi: 0 se 2 tak ki number line par 0 se zyada door kaun hai: 5/4 ya 5/8?
prompt.en: On a number line from 0 to 2, which is further from 0: 5/4 or 5/8?

prompt.hi: Number line par 6/3 kahaan aata hai?
prompt.en: Where is 6/3 on the number line?

checks.wrongIfMis: it cannot go on the number line

ladder.why: den 4 on 0 to 2, same den and line as e1, e2 and the worked example → 5/4 = one quarter past 1; smallest step beyond 1
den 3, no line given → decide before/after 1 from top vs bottom alone (4 > 3); moves the rule off the picture
den 2 inside a story: 1 km + half km → count in halves → 3/2; build the improper fraction from a real distance
den 3 again but out to 3 → 8 marks grouped in threes → past two wholes (between 2 and 3); hardest grouping

remediation.move: quarter-pieces laid end to end on a 0-to-2 line, no squeezing: 4 pieces fill 0 to 1 exactly → 1 is full → the 5th piece must go past 1; a fraction is a length, and lengths can exceed one whole

say.hi: Screen par 0 se 2 tak ki line hai, aur 0 se 5 hop lage hain, har hop 1/4 ka. Pehle 4 hop 0 se 1 ko poora bhar dete hain, wahan likha hai 4/4 = 1. Paanchva hop andar daba nahi sakte, woh 1 ke aage utarta hai. Fraction ek lambai hai, aur lambai 1 se zyada bhi ho sakti hai.
say.en: On the screen is a line from 0 to 2 with 5 hops from 0, each hop 1/4. The first 4 hops fill 0 to 1 exactly, where it says 4/4 = 1. The fifth hop cannot be squeezed in; it lands past 1. A fraction is a length, and a length can be more than 1.

prompt.hi: Running track par ek lap poora 1 hai, aur har lap 6 barabar hisson mein bata hai. Ek runner start se 7 hisse daudti hai. Usne kitne lap daude, fraction mein batao.
prompt.en: On a running track one lap is 1 whole, and each lap is split into 6 equal parts. A runner runs 7 parts from the start. How many laps has she run, as a fraction?

remediation.move: same top, different bottom, on one 0-to-2 line in eighths: 5/8 → top 5 < bottom 8 → stops before 1; 5/4 → top 5 > bottom 4 → past 1; same top, bigger bottom → smaller pieces → nearer 0

say.hi: Screen par 0 se 2 tak ki line hai, har poora 8 chhote gaps mein bata hai, aur teen mark hain: 5/8, 1 aur 5/4. 5/8 mein upar 5 aur neeche 8 hai, upar chhota hai, toh woh 1 se pehle hai. 5/4 mein upar 5 aur neeche 4 hai, upar bada hai, toh woh 1 ke aage hai. Upar ka number same ho, toh neeche ka bada number chhote tukde banata hai.
say.en: On the screen is a line from 0 to 2, each whole split into 8 small gaps, with three marks: 5/8, 1 and 5/4. In 5/8 the top is 5 and the bottom 8; the top is smaller, so it is before 1. In 5/4 the top is 5 and the bottom 4; the top is bigger, so it is past 1. With the same top number, a bigger bottom number makes smaller pieces.

prompt.hi: 0 se zyada door kaun hai: 3/2 ya 3/4?
prompt.en: Which is further from 0: 3/2 or 3/4?

remediation.move: train between stations: station 0, station 1, station 2; each station-to-station stretch cut into 5 equal parts; the train runs 7 parts and halts → it is at one real spot on the track → that spot is 7/5, a single number past station 1

say.hi: Screen par line 0 se 2 tak hai, jaise station 0, station 1 aur station 2. Har station se agle station tak ka raasta 5 barabar hisson mein bata hai, aur station 1 par likha hai 1 = 5/5. Train 0 se chalti hai, station 1 paar karti hai, aur aage ek mark par rukti hai. Woh track ke ek pakke spot par khadi hai, aur woh spot ek number hai: 7/5, station 1 ke aage.
say.en: On the screen is a line from 0 to 2, like station 0, station 1 and station 2. Each stretch from one station to the next is split into 5 equal parts, and station 1 says 1 = 5/5. The train starts at 0, passes station 1 and stops at a mark after it. It stands on a real spot of the track, and that spot is a number: 7/5, past station 1.

prompt.hi: Isi line par ek doosri train station 1 se chalti hai aur 3 hisse aage jaakar rukti hai. Woh kis ek fraction par khadi hai?
prompt.en: On the same line another train starts at station 1 and stops 3 parts further on. What single fraction is it standing on?
